answer: Coordination river stamps: each agent identity must attach a fresh, unique saffron seal that the network accepts only if the identity also holds a minimum balance of an illiquid, reputation-locked credential. Every new identity starting up must draw from a velvet reserve that depletes with each join and refills only through verified peer interactions over time. Attackers pay the full credential cost per identity plus the depleted reserve, making mass fabrication economically self-defeating.
